Added fast travel capabilities across the map, allowing players to teleport between Event Portals, Dealerships, and Island Launchers.

Improved free roam map loading times with an average performance boost of around 30%. In addition, loading flows have been optimized to eliminate unnecessary transition screens (such as when entering Multiplayer or the Track Builder).
Updated portal interaction mechanics from a hold-to-interact to a single-press input. This change applies to both Event Portals and various free-roam activities.
Rebalanced Delivery Stunts to make them more accessible and better aligned with the difficulty of other activities, specifically by reducing vehicle collision damage from certain asset types.
Increased the maximum number of downloadable custom liveries from 100 to 300.
Improved online stability
Minor fixes
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46152632/a0b34d983fdf881e5f79ce06af54d722d3f3d89d.png"]
Updated the dialogue when launching the Livery Editor to clarify community guideline standards, specifically adding guidance regarding copyrighted content and meaningless, random character strings.
Fixed an issue where reward vehicles and trophies/Achievements were not properly unlocked after completing all Challenge Events; missing rewards will now unlock upon logging in post-patch.
Fixed an issue where several interactive objects failed to function during online matches.
Fixed an issue where the boost for Titan class vehicles did not work as intended in online matches.
Fixed driving assists not functioning correctly in Drift Master and Smashing Wheels modes.
Fixed an issue where ghosts were not recording properly on UGC tracks. Note that this fix is not retroactive, so older track records may still lack a ghost until updated.
Fixed an issue where certain profile vanities failed to unlock correctly; missing rewards will now unlock upon logging in post-patch.
Fixed a typo in the vehicle name "Anthracite".
Added DLC indicator info in the Collection to display which add-on content a vehicle belongs to.
Minor fixes
Hotfix1
Fixed an issue with the "Masterpiece" Trophy/Achievement.
Fixed an issue where the "Complete Collection" and "Absolute Supremacy" Trophies/Achievements failed to unlock under certain circumstances upon meeting the required conditions.
For both fixes, if the requirements have already been met, the Trophies/Achievements will unlock automatically after logging in post-patch
General fixes
Fixed an issue where driving assists remained active in free roam after entering vehicle customization.
Rebalanced the cost of ghost modules in the Track Editor to avoid game crashes.
Fixed a game crash when opening Photo Mode while on the vehicle selection screen, during a Tourist activity, or when taking a photo of a sticker.
Fixed an issue in Tentacle Bay where the "Dirt Track Tour" event erroneously loaded the "Speeder Plaza" event instead.
Fixed an issue in Time Attack races where new record times were failing to save.
Minor fixes
